subject: Python
description: Python is a high-level, easy-to-learn language. Covers variables, data types, loops, functions, lists, dictionaries, OOP, and file handling. Used extensively in AI, Data Science, and Web Development.
topics: Introduction to Python;Variables & Data Types;Conditional Statements;Loops (for & while);Functions & Parameters;Lists & Dictionaries;File Handling;OOP Concepts

subject: NumPy
description: NumPy is the core library for scientific and array computing in Python. Learn multi-dimensional arrays, matrix math, broadcasting, vectorization, and fast numerical routines.
topics: NumPy Arrays;Array Indexing & Slicing;Array Math Operations;Broadcasting;Statistical Functions;Linear Algebra;Random Numbers

subject: Pandas
description: Pandas provides high-performance data structures like DataFrames and Series. Master data cleaning, filtering, CSV manipulation, groupby aggregations, and data preparation.
topics: Series & DataFrames;Reading & Writing CSV;Data Selection & Filtering;Handling Missing Data;GroupBy Operations;Merging DataFrames;Statistical Summary

subject: Matplotlib
description: Learn to build publication-quality data plots using Python. Covers line graphs, bar charts, scatter plots, histograms, customization of colors, titles, and saving high-res images.
topics: Pyplot Interface;Line Plots;Bar Charts;Scatter Plots;Histograms;Subplots;Labels & Legends;Saving Plots

subject: Seaborn
description: Seaborn is built on Matplotlib for beautiful statistical graphics. Learn heatmaps, violin plots, box plots, regression charts, and categorical data analysis.
topics: Distribution Plots;Box & Violin Plots;Bar & Count Plots;Heatmaps;Pair Plots;Color Palettes;Statistical Estimation

subject: Flask
description: Flask is a lightweight Python web framework. Learn URL routing, Jinja2 dynamic templates, handling HTTP forms, serving static assets, and structuring full-stack web applications.
topics: Routes & URLs;Jinja2 Templates;Form Handling & Validation;GET & POST Requests;Static Assets (CSS);Template Inheritance

subject: HTML
description: HTML is the standard markup language for creating web pages. Master page semantic layouts, forms, input types, audio/video elements, tables, and document structures.
topics: Document Structure;Headings & Text;Links & Images;Lists & Tables;Forms & Input Controls;Semantic HTML5;Media Tags

subject: CSS
description: CSS controls website styling and layouts. Learn flexbox, grid systems, keyframe animations, responsive design with media queries, and modern UI components.
topics: CSS Selectors;Colors & Typography;Box Model (Margin & Padding);Flexbox Layout;CSS Grid;Animations & Transitions;Responsive Media Queries

subject: JavaScript
description: JavaScript is the programming language of the interactive web. Learn variables (let/const), DOM manipulation, event listeners, ES6 features, promises, and async programming.
topics: Variables & Data Types;Arrow Functions;DOM Selection & Manipulation;Event Handling;Arrays & Objects;ES6+ Features;Async/Await

subject: C
description: C is a foundational low-level programming language. Learn pointers, memory allocation, structs, arrays, operators, and low-level system software development.
topics: Syntax & Types;Control Flow;Functions;Pointers & Memory;Arrays & Strings;Structures & Unions;File Handling

subject: C++
description: C++ adds object-oriented features to C. Master classes, objects, inheritance, polymorphism, encapsulation, templates, and the Standard Template Library (STL).
topics: Classes & Objects;Constructors & Destructors;Inheritance;Polymorphism;Encapsulation;Templates;Standard Template Library (STL)

subject: Java
description: Java is an enterprise-grade, platform-independent language. Learn JVM architecture, OOP concepts, exceptions, collection framework, and multi-threaded programming.
topics: Java Architecture;OOP Principles;Inheritance & Interfaces;Exception Handling;Collections Framework;Multithreading;File I/O

subject: SQL
description: SQL is used to manage and query relational databases. Learn table schema design, SELECT queries, WHERE filters, multi-table JOINs, aggregations, and normalization.
topics: Database Concepts;CREATE & INSERT;SELECT Queries;WHERE Filters;INNER & LEFT JOINs;GROUP BY & Aggregations;Database Normalization

subject: DSA
description: Master the core of computer science problem solving. Covers arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, trees, graphs, sorting, searching, and Big-O complexity analysis.
topics: Big-O Complexity;Arrays & Strings;Linked Lists;Stacks & Queues;Binary Trees;Graphs;Sorting Algorithms;Searching Algorithms

subject: OOP
description: Master the 4 pillars of OOP: Encapsulation, Abstraction, Inheritance, and Polymorphism. Learn to write clean, modular, maintainable, and reusable object-oriented code.
topics: Encapsulation;Data Hiding;Inheritance;Polymorphism;Abstraction & Interfaces;Design Patterns;SOLID Principles

subject: OS
description: Learn how operating systems bridge hardware and software. Covers processes, threads, CPU scheduling algorithms, virtual memory, paging, file systems, and deadlocks.
topics: Processes & Threads;CPU Scheduling (FCFS
column6: RR);Memory Management;Virtual Memory & Paging;File Systems;Deadlocks;Linux Basics

subject: Networking
description: Understand how computers connect and communicate globally. Learn OSI 7-layer model, TCP/IP, IP addressing, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS protocols, routing, and network security.
topics: OSI 7 Layers;TCP/IP Suite;IP Addressing & Subnetting;DNS & HTTP/HTTPS;Routing & Switching;Firewalls & Security Basics

subject: AI
description: An introduction to AI systems. Covers machine learning paradigms (supervised, unsupervised, reinforcement), neural networks, computer vision, and NLP.
topics: Introduction to AI;Supervised Learning;Unsupervised Learning;Neural Networks;Natural Language Processing;AI Applications

subject: Cybersecurity
description: Learn principles of securing systems and networks. Covers CIA triad, malware types, phishing, DDoS attacks, cryptography, firewalls, and ethical hacking.
topics: CIA Triad;Common Cyber Threats;Cryptography Basics;Network Firewalls;Two-Factor Authentication;Ethical Hacking Basics

subject: Software Engineering
description: Learn professional software engineering workflows. Covers SDLC models, Agile/Scrum sprints, Git version control, GitHub pull requests, and software testing.
topics: SDLC Models;Agile & Scrum Methodologies;Git Version Control;Branching & Merging;GitHub Workflow;Software Testing
